controls.derive_views_only: inverse views agree but a cycle remains
controls.drop_issued_operation: tree agrees but outcome and input accounting fail

kind: finite domain design exploration; no catalog implementation or formal proof
limits: finite enumeration plus named witnesses; no unbounded theorem
validity reference is separate; replay policy has no independent full semantic oracle
no memory concurrency, durable storage, transport, reclamation, or external effects
no Rust structure binding, kernel integration, or implementation conformance

profile.edits: fixed-universe reparent, no create/delete, no semantic prerequisites
profile.policy: replay from base; reject a move if its candidate is not a rooted tree

witnesses.late_operation: B changes from applied to rejected-cycle after earlier A arrives
witnesses.missing_dependency: dependent edit waits, then receives its deterministic outcome
witnesses.refusal: both replicas remain valid but different
